if: the supplier charges the recipient incidental expenses, including commission and packing
or the supplier charges any amount for anything done in respect of the supply at the time of, or before, delivery of goods or supply of services
then: those amounts are INCLUDED in the value of supply
note: Packing, commission and pre-delivery charges are part of the taxable base, not separate non-taxable recoveries. The timing test is 'at the time of, or before' delivery.
